description: Outdoor and science props for Toy Box Friends (pre-K to grade 2): science kit, plants (seed to flower in one shared pot), weather, vehicles and town, playground and habitats. Same format as ../models.json. Props face +z and stand on y = 0 unless the description says otherwise; vehicles face right (+x).

magnet.description: A red horseshoe magnet with silver tips, standing tips up (about 0.45 m tall).

paper_clip.description: A shiny metal paper clip standing on its long edge, facing the camera (0.24 m long). Recolour for coated clips.

flashlight.description: A chunky toy flashlight lying on its side, pointing right and a little towards the camera; the lens (named "lens") glows with the light material.

drum.description: A red toy drum with gold rims and white cords; the top skin is named "skin".

box_guitar.description: A shoebox guitar: an open cardboard box (open side to the front) with three rubber bands across it, named "band1" (low, red), "band2" (blue) and "band3" (green).

ice_cube.description: A frosty ice cube (0.25 m) in the ice material.

ice_pop.description: An orange ice pop on a wooden stick, standing on the stick end (0.45 m tall).

water_jug.description: A clear glass jug with a handle, half full of water (the water is named "water").

goggles.description: Kid safety goggles: two round see-through lenses in a yellow frame with blue side straps (0.47 m wide).

seed.description: A plant pot of soil with one big seed resting on top: stage 1 of the growing set (seed, sprout, seedling, plant, flowering_plant share the same pot).

sprout.description: A tiny sprout in the plant pot: a short stem with two little leaves (stage 2 of the growing set).

seedling.description: A seedling in the plant pot: a stem with four leaves (stage 3 of the growing set).

plant.description: A leafy plant in the plant pot: a stem and six leaves (stage 4 of the growing set).

flowering_plant.description: The leafy plant in its pot with a pink flower on top (stage 5 of the growing set).

watering_can.description: A green toy watering can with a long spout (pointing right, +x) and a yellow handle on top.

cactus.description: A friendly desert cactus with two arms and a pink flower on top (0.9 m tall); its spines are soft dots.

palm_tree.description: A tall palm tree with a gently curving trunk, eight fronds and three coconuts (2.2 m).

pumpkin.description: A round ribbed orange pumpkin with a brown stem and a little leaf (0.45 m).

lily_pad.description: A round floating lily pad with a notch and a little pink bud (0.8 m across, lying flat).

rock.description: A smooth grey rock with a smaller pebble beside it (0.5 m).

log.description: A fallen log lying left to right, with pale end rings and a little leafy twig (1 m long).

umbrella.description: An open red umbrella standing on its hooked handle, with a yellow tip and yellow trim (1.2 m tall).

snowman.description: A smiling snowman with blinking coal eyes, a carrot nose, a red scarf, twig arms and a little hat (1.25 m tall).

rain_cloud.description: A grey rain cloud with three blue raindrops under it (floats: its origin is the cloud's middle).

rainbow.description: A six-colour rainbow arch (red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) with a puffy cloud at each foot (2 m wide, 1 m tall); its middle is sky blue.

kite.description: A diamond kite on a string that sways gently in the wind, with a bow tail (its origin is the string's end; the kite flies 1.5 m up).

rocket.description: A toy rocket with a red nose and fins, a round window and a soft toy flame (named "flame") that flickers slowly under the nozzle (1.65 m tall).

train_engine.description: A toy steam train engine facing right (+x): red boiler, blue cab, black funnel, yellow cowcatcher, six wheels (1 m long). "<id>#wheels" turns all six wheels.

train_car.description: An open toy train wagon (no roof) so letters, numbers or toys can ride in it; the floor is 0.22 m up, the walls 0.3 m high (0.86 m long).

car.description: A little toy race car facing right (+x) with a bubble windscreen, a back spoiler, a white number disc and four wheels (0.9 m long).

boat.description: A toy sailboat facing right (+x): a round red hull, a white sail and a yellow flag (1.2 m tall). Its bottom sits on y = 0.

traffic_light.description: A traffic light on a pole with three glowing lamps named "red" (top), "yellow" and "green" (1.7 m tall). To switch a lamp off, move "<id>#red" (or yellow, green) by [0, 0, -0.12] so it sinks into the housing; move it back to light it.

stop_sign.description: A red octagon stop sign with a white border on a grey pole (1.4 m tall).

signpost.description: A wooden signpost with two arrow signs, one pointing left and one pointing right (1.3 m tall).

bin.description: A green rubbish bin with a lid (named "lid", hinged at its back edge: turn it about x, negative opens) (0.65 m tall).

bench.description: A park bench with orange wooden slats and dark legs; the seat is 0.4 m up (1.2 m wide).

seesaw.description: A playground seesaw: a red plank (named "plank", pivoting at its centre on the base; turn it about z) on a yellow base, with blue handles (2.2 m long).

slide.description: A playground slide: a ladder at the back (left), a blue platform and a yellow chute down to the right (1.3 m tall).

swing.description: A playground swing: a blue A-frame with a red top bar and a yellow seat (named "seat", hanging from the bar; turn it about x) that rocks a little (1.55 m tall). Turning "<id>#seat" about x swings the seat and its ropes together.

sandbox.description: A square sandbox with red and blue edges, a sand mound and a little sand castle (1.3 m across, 0.2 m high).

bucket.description: A blue toy bucket (open, so things can go in) with a yellow handle (0.45 m tall with the handle).

igloo.description: A snowy igloo: an ice-block dome with a round door tunnel at the front (1.6 m wide, 0.85 m tall).

den.description: A cosy animal den: a brown earth mound with a dark round doorway, pebbles around (1.8 m wide).

treasure_chest.description: A wooden treasure chest with gold bands, a gold lock and gold coins inside; the lid (named "lid") is hinged at its back top edge: turn it about x, about -100 to open (0.6 m wide).

compass_rose.description: A compass rose lying flat on the floor: a cream map disc with blue points and a red arrow marking North (pointing away from the camera, -z) (1.2 m across).

paper_plane.description: A folded paper plane pointing right (+x), wings in a shallow V (0.5 m long).
